text.tspan: The payout is worked out from the price feed and the position
the vault declared, never from its books.
The vault calls bind(position, retention, limit)
The Stylus pricer quotes each slice (v3)
The premium goes to the writers' vaults
and the limit is locked until settlement
setReference: feed round in effect at the close (v3)

g.text: Weekend: markets shut, the gap forms

text.tspan: fix: first feed round after the open

g.text: payout = min(limit, max(0, Σ losing legs of position × gap − retention))

text.tspan: Gap inside the retention: payout is 0,
